svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 1,320 mm of 38 x 2.5 S355 tube (trim to 1,305 after bending).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three bends, 115 mm centre-line radius, in a tube bender with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a 38 mm die. From the hitch end: 90 mm straight, bend 85

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: degrees left; 338 mm straight, bend 67 degrees right;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 237 mm straight, bend 67 degrees left; 198 mm straight.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The bends lie almost flat: the straight rear part sits 16 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: higher than the hitch end. Check on a table with a packer.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The rear 198 mm must be straight and round to slide in the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bushings: no dents, file off any weld spatter.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rear end: weld in a 33 mm plug, 15 mm long, tapped M10.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Overload pin hole: 12.2 mm, straight down through both walls,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 155 mm from the rear end, square to the last bend's plane.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hitch end: 6.2 mm locking pin hole, 30 mm from the end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the rear end slides through a 38.2 mm ring gauge.
